description: This file defines the ModuleProjectStaticFileProvider class, a custom implementation of IFileProvider for serving static files from module 'wwwroot' folders during development in OrchardCore.

classes.name: ModuleProjectStaticFileProvider
classes.description: A class implementing IModuleStaticFileProvider to serve static files from module 'wwwroot' directories during development.

methods.name: ModuleProjectStaticFileProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with application context and resolving module 'wwwroot' paths.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns directory contents; currently always returns not found.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file info for a given subpath if it exists within module 'wwwroot' directories.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Creates a change token to watch a specific file for changes.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes file paths by replacing backslashes with slashes and trimming slashes.
